Done. Here's the summary:

**Committed:** `5cb9f71` — `docs/competitor-ui-research.md` (479 lines)

**What was researched across 20+ web searches and page fetches:**

- **HailTrace** — Star rating system (1-5), Purple Zones for severity, color-graduated swaths, Honey Hole multi-swath overlay, property data download packages, dashboard analytics
- **JobNimbus** — Board card anatomy (name, financials, days-in-status, task ratio, attachments, assignees), Insights dashboards (KPI cards, pipeline funnel, leaderboards), SumoQuote multi-page proposals (cover page, inspection photos, authorization), Profit Tracker (planned vs actual + commissions)
- **RoofLink** — 7-step workflow visualization, photo-required milestone hard stops, 6-option Good/Better/Best estimates, profit-first compensation, CompanyCam auto-sync
- **Rooftops.ai** — Creator Studio (12+ content types), GPT assistant, AI Customer Service Bot, City Maps beta, AI Employees coming at $199/mo
- **QuoteIQ** — AI photo-based estimator, MapMeasure Pro satellite measurements, AI Virtual Call Team (outbound cold-calling), $29.99/mo with AI included

**Top 3 gaps identified:**
1. Server-side PDF estimates with cover page + inspection photos (vs SumoQuote)
2. Hail swath color graduation by severity (vs HailTrace)
3. AI-powered content generation (vs Rooftops.ai + QuoteIQ)

**Note:** Firecrawl credits are depleted (-123). All research was done via WebSearch + WebFetch fallback tools.
